title: Cover Letter Generation Output
description: Contract for POST /functions/v1/generate-cover-letter and the Python equivalent. Hard rules: no generic openers ('I am writing to apply...'), no hallucinated experience — every claim must trace to facts in the user's parsed resume/profile data. 250-400 words, 3-4 paragraphs.

cover_letter_markdown.description: Full cover letter in markdown. Structure: hook referencing a specific company project/value -> why this company -> why me (evidence + metrics from resume only) -> call to action.

overlap_skills.description: Top overlapping skills/experiences between resume and JD that the letter is built on.

company_hook.description: The specific company fact the opening references (must be grounded in provided company context; never invented).
